is Waypoint In

Property

The relation that obtains between a particular p and an eventuality e if and only if p is an intermediate point of movement or change in the context of e

For example

Specialisation

Asserting a sub-property asserts its own domain and range, not just the parent's. Anything you put either side is taken to be of the narrower class, whether or not you said so.

Note

The waypoint does not need to be a place, but it can be a thing or a period of time too
